rationale: EO 12753 (Nuclear Cooperation With EURATOM, signed March 8, 1991, 56 FR 10501) extends to March 10, 1992 the period in the first proviso to section 126a(2) of the Atomic Energy Act of 1954 and supersedes EO 12706 on its effective date. It is a fixed-term extension. EO 12791, signed March 9, 1992 (57 FR 8717), extends the period to March 10, 1993 and provides in the held Federal Register text: "Executive Order No. 12753 shall be superseded on the effective date of this Executive order." EO 12791 states no other effective date, so it took effect on signing, one day before the March 10, 1992 date in EO 12753's own terms; either way EO 12753 had ended by March 10, 1992 and nothing in it can be in force on 2026-10-14. The one history observation, the Federal Register disposition note "Supersedes: EO 12706, March 9, 1990 / Superseded by: EO 12791, March 9, 1992", agrees. Later extension orders (EO 12840, EO 12903) recite EO 12753 in their preambles but do not revoke or supersede it. Status: no.
